workType: ENCODE: front-load new factual/declarative learning + memorisation
SYNTHESISE: creative synthesis, architecture / system-design, connecting concepts

timing.peak1: 16:48–19:48  (hardest adversarial work: mocks, timed system-design, novel problems)
timing.blocks: ~90-min deep-focus blocks; genuine non-screen break between; movement snack every 30–60 min

tiers.verdict_driver: no sustained HIGH-confidence deviation — GREEN by default (the grind is honored)

medication.note: HR signals (RHR/HRV) + single-night temperature are medication-influenced (stimulant + caffeine + antipsychotic + SNRI classes) -> treated as LOW-confidence and can never drive a verdict alone. Judged only vs Nikhil's own medicated baseline, never textbook. Sleep-architecture trends, resilience, and sleep-vs-own-baseline carry the weight. This tool never comments on medication — see your doctor for that.
medication.boundary: Mood/agitation signal is intentionally NOT wired (by decision). If it ever were, any such flag would route to a 'show your doctor' report listing akathisia as a differential — never self-interpreted. Hard block on dose/diagnosis.

periodization.note: Sleep tracking near your own baseline (~6.5h). Load OK — coach on trends, not one night.

safety.message: No sustained red-flag physiology detected. (This tool never comments on medication; anything med-related is a doctor question.)

guardrail: Read this once, act on it, then close the app. Coach on TRENDS, not a single day. If you feel great, a mediocre score DOWNGRADES the plan — it does not abort it (nocebo guard).
